[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- 03_advanced_iot.volt:4[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 2 must be HIGH at boot. Often connected to onboard LED.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 2
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- UNHANDLED FAILURE -- 03_advanced_iot.volt:75[/yellow bold]

`wifi.connect` has no fallback if it fails.

 [dim]74 |[/dim] setup {
 [dim]75 |[/dim]     wifi.connect("HomeNet", "password")
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Without one the program carries on offline. Add `or retry(5)` to try again, `or skip` to carry on, or `or restart` to reboot.[/cyan]

`mqtt.connect` has no fallback if it fails.

 [dim]75 |[/dim]     wifi.connect("HomeNet", "password")
 [dim]76 |[/dim]     mqtt.connect("mqtt://192.168.1.100")
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Without one the program carries on offline. Add `or retry(5)` to try again, `or skip` to carry on, or `or restart` to reboot.[/cyan]
